_comment: Canonical revolution-path mapping for the ANW mod. Used by build_release_readiness_site.py to render the 'Revolution paths' block on every civ card. Source of truth: gRvltCivId table in game/ai/leaders/leader_revolution_commanders.xs + AoE3 DE base-game politicians (Spanish→Mexicans, British→Americans, etc.) + ANW mod additions (Mexicans→Texians/RioGrande/Yucatan/Mayans/BajaCalifornians/Californians). Keys are civ_label values (the clean nation name, not the spec token). Edit this file directly to fix the data; the site rebuilds from it.
_target_to_parents_comment: Inverted view for civs that are themselves revolution targets. Multi-parent entries (e.g. South Africans from both British and Dutch) reflect historically contested colonial provenance.
_doctrine_notes_comment: Optional short historical doctrine note shown under each revolution-target name (so the user can see the *flavour* of each path at a glance). Keyed by target civ_label.
